title: Everlaw's office book club read the book, then heard Eric at The AI Conference — 'I went in expecting to think more about models. I came out thinking much more about systems'
summary: A senior engineer at the legal-tech company Everlaw describes reading Incorruptible with colleagues at their office book club, then hearing Eric speak weeks later at The AI Conference. He calls the sequence surreal, and names the shift it produced: he arrived thinking about models and left thinking about systems.
blockquote: A little surreal to read Eric Ries’ Incorruptible at our office book club, then hear him talk about those ideas in the context of a rapidly evolving AI world weeks later.
